The climate in Lovech

Lovech is about 180 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 30°C; the coldest is January, when nights average −2°C. Around 710 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in June (about 107 mm).

Lovech lies in the Osam valley in the Fore-Balkan, between the Danubian Plain and the Balkan Mountains. The climate is moderate continental but wetter than on the plain because of the nearby mountain slopes. Summers are warm and winters cold, and in the narrow river gorge cold air and fog linger longer.

Best time to visit Lovech

The most pleasant weather in Lovech is usually in September and October: average highs are between 20°C and 26°C, with up to 7 days of rain a month. In August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
